assumptions.tau_note: default tau is the parent Ttr guide's certified U (off-target no worse than the parent)
assumptions.U_definition: U(g) = ||P_alpha(mouse TRRUST)||_2 * ||e_seed||_2, a certified upper bound on the propagated off-target; U <= tau is exact.
assumptions.conformal: Jin and Candes split-conformal p-values + Benjamini-Hochberg, calibrated on the held-out real Huesken split; the efficacy FDR control is approximate because the enumerated candidates are not exchangeable with the Huesken population.
